_README: SEBS goal-based Core Curriculum, 2026-2027 catalog, encoded once and composed with every SEBS program (Prompt 08 B1).

Every quote is verbatim from the archived capture it names (data/programs/rutgers/sources.json). Course eligibility comes from SOC coreCodes PER TERM, using the codes the catalog prints in brackets; SOC itself labels ECN and GVT 'SEBS Core: ...'.

Pending human review. The bracket-to-SOC crosswalk, the Natural Sciences discipline condition and the experiential certification are listed as review questions / rules not yet modeled - nothing is assumed.

school.name: School of Environmental and Biological Sciences

applicability.note: First-year and transfer students matriculating fall 2019 and later.

degree_credits.title: SEBS Credits and Residency, 2026-2027 catalog
degree_credits.quote: To be awarded a degree, a student in the School of Environmental and Biological Sciences must complete a minimum of 120 credits* of coursework with a cumulative grade-point average of 2.000 or better.

sources.note: sebs.rutgers.edu/core returned HTTP 403 to a plain GET on 2026-11-11; the department source is an open evidence gap.

quotes.quote: First-year and transfer students matriculating fall 2019 and later must complete a goal-based Core Curriculum .
Only graded degree credit-bearing courses worth at least 3 credits and certified by the faculty may be used to meet core goals.

Courses may be counted as meeting multiple learning goals; students generally will complete the core in 10 to 13 courses of 3 or 4 credits each. A course used to meet core goals may also be used to fulfill a major or minor requirement.
(6 credits) Students must take two courses and meet one goal in each of the Contemporary Challenges areas. [CC-D, CC-O]
Diversities and Social Inequalities [CC-D]
Our Common Future [CC-O]

requirements.name: Experiential Learning
requirements.notes: SOC certifies XPL ('Experiential Learning') on very few offerings; an approved experience may not be a course at all. A missing XPL course is never read as 'no experiential option'.

quotes.quote: (3 credits) Practical application of disciplinary knowledge. Students must participate in a certified experience that meets this goal. [EL]
Areas of Inquiry

requirements.name: Natural Sciences
requirements.notes: Two courses certified NS. The condition that they come from two different disciplines (physical, biological or environmental sciences) is NOT modeled - see rules_not_yet_modeled.

quotes.quote: Natural Sciences (6 credits) Students must meet two goals with courses in two of the following disciplines: physical, biological or environmental sciences. [NS]
Historical Analysis (3 credits) Students must meet one goal. [HST]
Social Analysis (6 credits) Students must meet one goal in each area below. [SCL]
Social Cultural Analysis/ Economic Analysis (3 credits) [SCL-SCA/ECN]
Governance and Regulation Analysis (3 credits) [SCL-GVT]

requirements.name: Arts and Humanities
requirements.notes: The catalog prints [AH] and lists four goals whose wording matches SOC's AHo/AHp/AHq/AHr descriptions; the crosswalk is a review question.

quotes.quote: Arts and Humanities (3 credits) Students must meet one goal. [AH]
Cognitive Skills and Processes
Writing and Communication (6 credits) Students must meet one goal in two areas. [WC, WCd]

requirements.name: College Writing
requirements.notes: The catalog names College Writing (101), Extended College Writing (104) and Exposition and Argument (103) without a subject code; eligibility uses SOC's WC certification rather than assuming the subject.

quotes.quote: College Writing (101) or Extended College Writing (104) or Exposition and Argument (103) (3 credits) [WC]
Writing in a Discipline (3 credits) [WCd]
Quantitative and Formal Reasoning (6 credits) Students must meet two goals. [QQ; QR]
Formulate, evaluate, and communicate conclusions and inferences from quantitative information. (Includes various quantitative methods courses as well as 640 courses) [QQ]
Apply effective and efficient mathematical or other formal processes to reason and to solve problems. (Includes 640 courses and formal reasoning course--or placement out of) [QR]
must complete a minimum of 120 credits* of coursework with a cumulative grade-point average of 2.000 or better

school_rules.name: 30 of the last 42 credits at Rutgers
school_rules.not_evaluable_reason: Needs certified attempt institution and a chronological window over the last 42 credits; CoursePilot does not yet evaluate rolling residency windows.

quotes.quote: In addition, the student must complete 30 of the last 42 credits at Rutgers.

school_rules.name: Pass/No Credit limited to unspecified electives
school_rules.not_evaluable_reason: The quoted P/NC limit appears under the catalog's area requirements for students matriculating prior to fall 2015; the current-cohort policy page (sebs.rutgers.edu) returned HTTP 403. Not evaluated.

quotes.quote: Students who have completed at least 60 credits of coursework may register for up to two of these unspecified elective courses (no more than one per semester) on a Pass/No Credit basis.

rules_not_yet_modeled.rule: Natural Sciences: the two courses must come from two different disciplines (physical, biological or environmental sciences).
rules_not_yet_modeled.why_not: No source-backed course-to-discipline mapping is archived; a subject-code guess would invent one.

rules_not_yet_modeled.rule: Experiential Learning may be met by a certified experience that is not a course.
rules_not_yet_modeled.why_not: No verified experiential-approval evidence kind exists yet; only XPL-certified offerings are eligible, and their absence is never read as 'no option'.

rules_not_yet_modeled.rule: Environmental Engineering students complete at least 129 credits.
rules_not_yet_modeled.why_not: A program-level total; it belongs to the Environmental Engineering encoding (Phase C), not the school component.

unknowns: The current SEBS Core page and Pass/No Credit policy on sebs.rutgers.edu (HTTP 403 to a plain GET).
Whether every SOC-certified CCD/CCO/NS/HST/SCL/AH/WC/WCd/QQ/QR course is certified for SEBS students (the catalog says lists are in Degree Navigator).
review_questions: Confirm the bracket-to-SOC crosswalk: CC-D->CCD, CC-O->CCO, EL->XPL, SCL-SCA/ECN->SCL or ECN, SCL-GVT->GVT, AH->AHo/AHp/AHq/AHr, WC->WC, WCd->WCd, QQ->QQ, QR->QR.
Social Analysis: the catalog bracket is [SCL-SCA/ECN]. Confirm that a course certified SCL (without ECN) meets the Social Cultural Analysis/Economic Analysis area.
Confirm the 120-credit total applies to SEBS students in the 2026-2027 catalog (the Core page's 128-credit Area IX is for students matriculating prior to fall 2015).
